mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deepening labor market crisis, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected corporate earnings contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand collapse, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS does not produce a statistically significant negative correlation with SPX 20-day returns (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary easing cycles, a decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals central bank commitment to economic stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of active monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline ≥0.5% in last month), SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals real economy contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected corporate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 2% from previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index decline below 1.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflation, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as central bank policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A nonfarm payrolls decline exceeding 100,000 (PAYEMS) signals severe labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with immediate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to market panic around labor market deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in the last month.
